item.title: Campbell County gas prices steady as national average dips slightly
item.description: GILLETTE, Wyo. — Campbell County’s average fuel price trailed the national average as both fell less than a penny in the last week. item.title: Governor’s Capitol Art Exhibition opens Feb. 9 in Cheyenne
item.description: CHEYENNE, Wyo. — The 2026 Governor’s Capitol Art Exhibition will open Monday, Feb. 9 at the Wyoming Capitol, showcasing a survey of the state’s contemporary art scene. The biennial exhibition, held in the Capitol Gallery, features 62 works by 53 artists. This year’s selections were curated from 383 entries submitted by 152 Wyoming artists.
